title: SabinePass_0552.wav by naturenutt
author: naturenutt
sourceDescription: This was an interesting set of waves to record, mainly a test just to see what would work and what would not. Recorded on a Marantz PMD661 (super mod from OadeBrothers) with 2 Rode NT1A mic's at 120 degree mic angle/20 cm's apart/SRA 42 degrees (kind of a narrower Olson stereo technique, which is 20cm/135 degrees/SRA 38.4), and about 24 inches off the ground. Also used 4-inch long fur on the wind cage surrounding the mics, an enclosure I custom-built to block the wind from the mics (kind of resembles a deer-feeder with 3 telescoping legs). It was recorded on Nov. 15, 2010 in the late afternoon
modifications: cut 172.88-178.88s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -7.00 dBFS); 30 ms fades
